text: 新易盛：控股股东、实际控制人、董事长高光荣提议公司以集中竞价交易方式回购股份，回购资金总额不低于8亿元（含）且不超过10亿元（含），价格不高于董事会审议通过回购方案决议前30个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%，用于股权激励计划或员工持股计划，回购期限为自董事会审议通过回购方案之日起十二个月内。
text_en: Eoptolink: Controlling shareholder, actual controller and chairman Gao Guangrong proposed that the company repurchase shares through centralized bidding transactions, with the total repurchase amount no less than RMB 800 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 1 billion (inclusive), at a price no higher than 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares in the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase plan, for use in an equity incentive plan or employee stock ownership plan, with the repurchase period within twelve months from the date the board approves the repurchase plan.
